source: FDE Training Plan and the Weeks 1–2 Kickoff

assignments.title: P1: a small call-log app
deliver: GitHub repo link (your own account, short README)
Public links to the React page (Vercel) and the API (Render)
The curl command and Postman request you used to add a call
assignments.done_when: The page and the API run on public URLs, and a curl POST adds a row that shows up on the React page.

assignments.title: P2: a LiveKit voice bot
deliver: GitHub repo link with the code and your prompt
Screen recording of a 2-minute conversation with your bot
Notes on 3 setting changes: what you changed, expected and saw
assignments.done_when: You can hold a 2-minute conversation with the bot, and you have notes on 3 setting changes.

assignments.title: P3: a signed post-call webhook from P2 to P1
deliver: Screen recording: a call adds a row, and a bad signature is rejected
Links to your updated P1 and P2 repos
assignments.done_when: You end a call with your bot and it appears on your P1 page, and a request with a bad signature is rejected.

assignments.title: Campaign call lifecycle diagram, from memory
deliver: A diagram from pre-call to the webhook

assignments.title: 5-minute client explainer: SIP vs no-SIP, and LLM wrong answers
deliver: A 5-minute recording: when each setup fits, why an LLM gives wrong answers and two ways to reduce them

assignments.title: P4: a dummy app with the RevRag SDK
deliver: Screen recording of P4 working
GitHub repo link
assignments.done_when: The agent appears on your chosen screens, and you can hold a conversation with it inside the app.

assignments.title: 10-minute SDK walkthrough for a client developer
deliver: A 10-minute recording using P4 as the example

assignments.title: Debug one real past issue with the RevRag MCP
deliver: A short note: was it the prompt, the config, the code or the client's side?

assignments.title: Two A/B test designs: one campaign, one in-app
deliver: What you split, what you measure, and how many users you need

assignments.title: P5: a Lambda that stores calls in DynamoDB
deliver: GitHub repo link with the Lambda code
Screen recording: a bot call is saved in DynamoDB, and a request without the key is rejected
assignments.done_when: A curl request with the key saves a record in DynamoDB, a request without the key is rejected, and you can find both in the logs.

assignments.title: Lambda, DynamoDB or S3 for three client requests
deliver: A short note per request on which service and why

assignments.title: Trace one partner request through hooks.revrag.ai
deliver: The trace

assignments.title: Answer 5 questions from a past security questionnaire
deliver: Your answers

assignments.title: Session 1: platform docs and infosec (product team)
deliver: Read the docs introduction and skim every docs page first
Deliverables set by the product team

assignments.title: Session 2: scoping and solution design (customer success)
deliver: Read 'What are Forward Deployed Engineers?' first
Deliverables set by the customer success team
